territories.name: Niger
territories.legal_reference: Directive 2006/112/EC, article 5(2): the common system of VAT applies in the territory of the Community as defined by the Treaties, and a State outside it is a third country for every rule the Directive carries. Niger levies a value added tax of its own under its Code général des impôts (ordonnance n° 2025-22 du 14 juillet 2025, in force since 1 January 2026, succeeding the code of 2012 whose article 226 set the rates), harmonised within the West African Economic and Monetary Union by Directive n° 02/98/CM/UEMOA as amended by Directive n° 02/2009/CM/UEMOA.
